game_concept: A racing platformer set in The Kingdom – Royal Granary, the king's grain stores: the squire must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Granary: the king's grain stores
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Granary, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the squire ahead. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the castle gate by solving code steps involving a that move the squire forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the castle gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Royal Granary'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
